study type: Multigenerational retrospective cohort with prospective data collection
cohort: The cohort includes grandmothers (born 1939-1986), mothers (born 1981-2003) and their children (born 1996-2018) who were born and subsequently had their own pregnancies in Nova Scotia, Canada, from 1980 onward.
finding: The 3G Multigenerational Cohort, a population-based dynamic retrospective cohort spanning 38 years, has been established to investigate inter- and transgenerational associations across the maternal line, with preliminary data including 14,978 grandmothers, 16,766 mothers, and 28,638 children as of October 2018.
